What to Bring on a Party Bus: Essential Checklist

You've booked the party bus—now make sure you're prepared for an epic experience. This checklist covers everything from must-haves to nice-to-haves.

The Must-Haves

Beverages

  • Alcohol (if BYOB policy)
  • Mixers - Juice, soda, tonic
  • Ice - Usually provided, confirm
  • Non-alcoholic options - Water, sports drinks
  • Cups - Solo cups work great

Personal Items

  • ID - Required at all venues
  • Phone - Charged!
  • Charger/power bank - Long nights drain batteries
  • Cash - For tips, venues, emergencies
  • Credit/debit cards - Backup payment

Entertainment

  • Playlist - Pre-made Spotify/Apple Music
  • Bluetooth speaker - If bus system disappoints
  • Games - Cards, travel games
  • Decorations - Balloons, banners (confirm with company)

Nice-to-Haves

Comfort Items

  • Flat shoes - For the return trip
  • Jacket/wrap - AC can be cold
  • Touch-up kit - Makeup, hair products
  • Breath mints - Always a good idea
  • Sunglasses - Morning-after essential

Fun Additions

  • Camera - Dedicated photo device
  • Props - Photo booth accessories
  • Snacks - Crackers, pretzels
  • Gum - Share with the group
  • Wet wipes - Multi-purpose lifesaver

Event-Specific Additions

Bachelor Party

  • Matching shirts
  • Groom sash
  • Golf gear (if applicable)
  • Cigar cutter/lighter

Bachelorette Party

  • Bride sash/veil
  • Ring toss game
  • Photo props
  • Matching accessories

Wine Tour

  • Wine carrier for purchases
  • Cooler for bottle preservation
  • Cheese/crackers
  • Blanket for picnic stops

Prom/Formal

  • Corsage/boutonniere
  • Dress shoes
  • Emergency sewing kit
  • Hair spray

Birthday

  • Decorations (pre-approved)
  • Birthday sash
  • Party poppers
  • Cake (confirm with company)

What NOT to Bring

Prohibited Items

  • Illegal substances - Zero tolerance
  • Glass bottles - Many companies prohibit
  • Open flames - Candles, lighters (inside)
  • Weapons - Obviously
  • Excessive luggage - Limited space

Bad Ideas

  • Glitter - Cleaning fees apply
  • Silly string - Same reason
  • Pets - Unless pre-approved
  • Outside furniture - Yes, people try

Group Coordination

Before Boarding

  1. Collect everyone's ID
  2. Confirm headcount
  3. Pool money for tips
  4. Share emergency contacts
  5. Designate a "captain"

Assign Roles

  • DJ - Controls the music
  • Photographer - Documents everything
  • Treasurer - Manages group fund
  • Navigator - Communicates with driver
  • Timekeeper - Ensures schedule

Packing Tips

Bag Strategy

  • One main cooler for drinks
  • One snack bag
  • Personal items stay on person
  • Designate a bag drop area

Space Awareness

  • Party buses have limited storage
  • Don't block aisles or exits
  • Use overhead racks if available
  • Keep valuables visible

Pro Tips

  1. Pre-portion drinks - Avoid glass bottles
  2. Label everything - Phone chargers walk away
  3. Photo early - Before things get messy
  4. Eat beforehand - Don't drink on empty
  5. Water between drinks - Stay functional

Book your party bus and get ready for an unforgettable ride.
